knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 1.2.1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Claim counts per policy-year: many zeros, a long right tail of large counts. Aim: explore the frequency shape before modelling. (1) Name one exploratory visualisation you would use and what pattern it should reveal. (2) Name one visualisation or summary misuse you would refuse for this aim.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) A bar/histogram of counts (or a zero-aware frequency plot) to reveal the mass at zero and the right tail. (2) Refuse a pie chart of policies or a mean-only table that hides zero-inflation and the tail.
